name: Farm Idle: Coop
subtitle: A cozy little chicken farm
description: Care for a little flock and grow a cheerful farm. Fill the trough, gather eggs, sell your harvest for farm coins, and fill your neighbors’ orders. Expand your coop, soften the nesting beds, and make room for grain. Complete three tasks in a fresh weekly fair every Monday. Progress continues using your device’s clock while you are away, as long as the hens have feed and the nest has room. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep your farm in sight. Entirely free, entirely offline. No account, advertising, purchases, tracking, or real money. Farm coins are earned only inside the game.
